title: Counting exactness at two and three bodies of overlap
caption: Exact of reached walks when the count runs on the annotation's boxes, at two and three bodies of overlap, for each arm of the counting evidence. The 100 percent cells are 834 of 834 from C2 on 76 VerSe spines at three bodies, and at two bodies 618 of 618 on 79 CTSpinoPelvic1K renders, 95 of 95 on 16 real lumbar films and 110 of 110 on 24 real films from C2.
